Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Floating Companion Controls Redesign: Redesign the final home intro screen into a full-bleed visual layout highlighting quick desktop shortcuts, hiding options, and interaction modes. (why: Support received multiple tickets regarding confusion on how to control or hide the pet, and the finish step has a 64.8% completion rate with very long mean dwell time.)
1: [home, new_screen] Desktop Spawn Check Visual Screen: Insert a new verification step right after waiting to display a preview of the rendered desktop pet and confirm window visibility before entering main app. (why: Users reported pets failing to show on desktop or custom pet generation looking broken, causing drop-offs during waiting and home transition.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Late Sign-In Conversion Reorder: Move sign-in to occur after pet selection and certificate adoption, placing account creation right before generation waiting. (why: Asking users to sign in as step 2 leads to an early 20% churn before users have established emotional commitment to a specific pet.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Sign-In Cloud Save Protection Copy Reassurance: Update sign-in headline and hint copy to emphasize that logging in preserves existing pets and cloud progress permanently. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing back in, causing reluctance to complete sign-in.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Choose Path Compact Split Screen Layout: Switch choose_path layout to a split view displaying pet paths side by side with visual feature comparisons. (why: Mean time spent on choose_path is 514s, showing decision paralysis on the current path layout.)
5: [finish, notification] Home Intro Desktop Shortcuts Hint Notification: Add a desktop readiness notification toggle and prominent quick control hint on home_intro. (why: 3 support tickets involved post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control or hide the pet once created.)

scores.note: Finish step has high churn (35.2% drop) and extreme dwell time, backed by multiple support tickets. Requires UI release.
Fixes broken desktop pet render complaints, but adding a brand new screen introduces extra friction.
